candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Return the caller (msg.sender) instead of the stored owner.
Return the reward distributor address instead of the stored owner.
Delete the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
Delete the _transferOwnership call so the owner is never updated.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) so the owner is always set to the caller.
Delete the `_;` statement so the guarded function body (and thus the ownership update) never executes.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from setRewardDistributor so any caller can change the distributor.
Set rewardDistributor to msg.sender instead of the _distributor parameter.
Delete the assignment so rewardDistributor never changes.
Invert the ownership check in _checkOwner so the owner's call reverts while a non-owner passes the modifier.
